name: C4-2 Self-attention over a tokenised sentence
description: 14 characters, 25 tokens, a 25x25 map; needs a download

params.value: 她去了那家貓咖啡因為它很可愛

params.label: Attention weights (T, T) — one row per token, each summing to 1

data.noteContent:
Self-attention on real text instead of a random tensor. The sentence goes through cl100k_base, which splits Chinese into UTF-8 bytes, so fourteen characters come out as twenty-five tokens and the matrix labels are byte fragments rather than words.

Out of that comes a 25x25 matrix, one row per token, every row summing to one. The projections are random, so this run's weights sit between 0.013 and 0.086, close to the 0.04 a flat row would give. Read the shape and the three steps, not which token attended to which.

Put an English sentence in TextInput for one token per word and readable labels; C4-4 shows that. The first run downloads the cl100k_base table, later runs are offline.

這裡的自注意力跑的是真實文字，不是隨機張量。句子先經過 cl100k_base，它會把中文拆成 UTF-8 位元組，所以十四個字變成二十五個 token，矩陣上的標籤也就是位元組碎片，不是詞。

算出來的是 25x25 的矩陣，每個 token 一列，每一列加起來是 1。投影矩陣是隨機的，所以這次執行的權重落在 0.013 到 0.086 之間，很接近完全平均時的 0.04。這裡要看的是形狀和那三個步驟，不是誰注意了誰。

把 TextInput 換成英文句子，就會一個字一個 token、標籤也讀得懂；C4-4 就是那個樣子。第一次執行會下載 cl100k_base 表，之後就不需要網路。

cl100k_base is GPT-4's byte-pair vocabulary, and it was fitted mostly on English. A Latin word is usually one token; a Chinese character is two or three, and no single piece is a whole character, which is why the labels come out as replacement marks.

cl100k_base 是 GPT-4 的 byte-pair 詞彙表，主要用英文語料訓練出來。一個英文單字通常就是一個 token；一個中文字會拆成兩三塊，而且每一塊單獨看都不是完整的字，所以標籤才會變成替代符號。

Three steps, in order: every query meets every key as a dot product, a softmax across each row turns those scores into weights summing to one, and the output row is those weights applied to the values. temperature divides the scores first - below 1 sharpens a row, above 1 flattens it.

三個步驟，照順序來：每個 query 和每個 key 做內積，對每一列做 softmax 把分數變成加起來為 1 的權重，輸出那一列就是用這些權重去加權 value。temperature 會先除分數 — 小於 1 讓一列更集中，大於 1 讓它更平。
